CustomField.description: This is an automated field that calculates the target owner's current month pipeline target amount based on the amount entered in the current month target field.
CustomField.formula: CASE( MONTH( TODAY() ), 1, Pipeline_Target_Jan__c, 2, Pipeline_Target_Feb__c, 3, Pipeline_Target_Mar__c, 4, Pipeline_Target_Apr__c, 5, Pipeline_Target_May__c, 6, Pipeline_Target_Jun__c, 7, Pipeline_Target_Jul__c, 8, Pipeline_Target_Aug__c, 9, Pipeline_Target_Sep__c, 10, Pipeline_Target_Oct__c, 11, Pipeline_Target_Nov__c, 12, Pipeline_Target_Dec__c, 0 )
CustomField.label: Pipeline Target (CM)
